[SWS_CM_10310] Source of a SOME/IP response message
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00007,
RS_SOMEIP_00010
⌈
The SOME/IP response message shall use the unicast
IP
address defined in the
Manifest by the
Ipv4Configuration
/
Ipv6Configuration
attribute of the
Net-
workEndpoint
that is referenced (in role
unicastNetworkEndpoint
) by the
Eth-
ernetCommunicationConnector
of a
Machine
which in turn is mapped to the
ProvidedSomeipServiceInstance
by means of a
SomeipServiceInstance-
ToMachineMapping
as source address for the transmission. The port number con-
figured via
udpPort
shall be used to derive the source port for the transmission in case
the selected transport protocol (see [SWS_CM_10309]) is
UDP
. If this port number is
configured to 0, an
ephemeral
port shall be used. If the port number is configured to
a value different from 0 exactly that port shall be used. The port number configured
via
tcpPort
shall be used to derive the source port for the transmission in case the
selected transport protocol (see [SWS_CM_10309]) is
TCP
. If this port number is con-
figured to 0, an
ephemeral
port shall be used. If the port number is configured to a
value different from 0 exactly that port shall be used.
⌋
